如何使用本平台 · How to use this platform
第一層 Layer 1（約 30 秒快速上手）· 第二層 Layer 2（讀懂介面）· 第三層 Layer 3（術語表）。僅供參考 — 即時狀態請開 Dashboard。
操作員速查 · Operator quick read
現在 · Now — 今日狀態（例：MONITOR ONLY · Deploy blocked）
原因 · Why — 為何被擋（例：Board stale · Brief expired 26d · IBKR offline · Runtime conflict）
可做 · Allowed — 刷新看板、建立監察規則、開 Playbook 複核
禁止 · Blocked — 不定倉、不交接券商、不可試探倉
下一步 · Next — 先做一件事（例：修復 IBKR → 再刷新看板）
Playbook = 候選名單（非交易指令）· Dossier confirm-only = 結構確認（非交易計劃）· Funds = 研究模式（非配置指令）
⚠️ Current Build Reality Check Expand
Platform state varies: live, fallback, mock, partial-sync, or diagnostics-first.
• Ranked ≠ deployable · Connected ≠ execution-ready
• Broker truth may differ from local research book
• Probe health ≠ runtime health · Research ≠ trade permission
📘 Random Walk — Global Principles (8) Expand
Constitution layer — apply on every surface (Dashboard, Playbook, Dossier, Portfolio, Funds). Read net edge after cost; humility labels are supportive, not excuses to trade.
1. Markets are noisy in the short run — favor regime and process over daily noise.
2. Page-level regime overrides single-name temptation — board gate beats a pretty card.
3. Research relevance does not equal deploy permission — Discovery/Flow/Funds/RS inform only.
4. Cost-adjusted edge matters more than raw signal strength — read Raw · Net after cost.
5. Portfolio construction matters more than isolated ideas — correlated stories are one bet.
6. Cash is a valid allocation — patience when edge is unclear is risk management.
7. Avoid overconfidence in forecasting — scenarios and invalidation beat point predictions.
8. Bubble conditions require extra skepticism — crowding and extension need explicit discount.
Humility labels: supportive only · likely priced in · evidence incomplete · monitoring only · not enough advantage over passive baseline · research signal only · narrative-rich, evidence-light · cost drag may erase weak edge · high structure, low predictive certainty
Naval principles (signal-light): specific knowledge beats borrowed conviction · preserve mental bandwidth · suppress false urgency · process leverage over labor churn · compounding patience when board says WAIT — see docs/NAVAL_ALMANAC_UPGRADE.md
Buffett principles (owner judgment): understand the business · economic quality and moat · honest capital allocation · stay inside circle of competence · patience when board says WAIT — see docs/BUFFETT_BIOGRAPHY_UPGRADE.md
⚡ Layer 1 — Quick Start ~30 seconds
Operator checklist
  • Page gate beats card rank — WAIT/NO_TRADE caps deploy surfaces · 頁面門檻優先於卡片排名
  • Research ≠ permission — Discovery, Flow, Funds, RS inform only · 研究 ≠ 可部署
  • Dashboard first — live board posture; Guide is reference only · 先看 Dashboard 今日狀態
Most common mistakes
  • Don't size from fallback cards — FALLBACK WATCH / Brief expired = monitor-only · 備援或過期簡報不可定倉
  • Don't treat IBKR LOGIN as execution-ready — GATEWAY UP · LOGIN REQUIRED still blocks handoff · 已登入 Gateway ≠ 可下單
  • Don't treat Discovery / Flow / RS as deploy permission — research-only surfaces · 掃描結果 ≠ 部署許可
  • Don't treat Backtest Lab as live evidence — historical simulation, not deployment authority · 回測 ≠ 實盤依據
When capital is allowed / blocked
Capital allowed when
☑Scoped freshness — Market/Board/Brief/Broker/Runtime fresh; header shows per-scope labels, not one global pill
☑Engine confirmed — header + Ops agree; badge alone ≠ fresh cycle
☑IBKR READY — session active, not LOGIN-only; bracket aligned
☑Board gate open — not WAIT/NO_TRADE; entry + stop + execution_ready
Capital blocked when
Engine OFF/stale · board WAIT/NO_TRADE · Authority: Blocked · IBKR LOGIN-only or disconnected · bracket missing · fallback / confirm-only dossier (Structure Review Only) · research-only / mock surfaces · no pilot entry — full list in Layer 3.
Surfaces: Core decides · Research-only supports · Diagnostic / Execution-dependent confirms — details in Layer 3.
研究介面快速上手 · Research surfaces
以下三個介面只有研究權限，不會下單、不會調倉。空狀態時看「如何開始」卡片。
🤖 Agent 盯盤 · 僅監察 · Monitor only（More → Command）
輸入一句話建立監察規則，例如「當 KO 跌破 20 日線時提醒我」。可從 Playbook Watch 名單一鍵建立規則。
🧪 策略實驗室 · Strategy Lab（More 選單）
輸入策略 ID（如 defensive_pullback）→ 產生研究草稿 → 驗證後轉 Watch 規則 → 到 Playbook 審閱。不具部署權限。
🧾 影子帳戶 · Shadow account（Ops → Shadow）
先匯入 CSV 交易紀錄，或連接 IBKR 歷史成交。可看勝率、持倉時間、過早平倉等行為診斷（研究用）。
📖 Layer 2 — How to Read the Platform Expand
🔝 Header bar — 4 layers
Status is four layers, not just LIVE/PAPER/SYNTHETIC. Check all four before trusting any card:
① Scoped truth strip (header example)
Educational example — live header uses Market:/Board:/Brief:/Broker:/Runtime:/Authority: labels.
Market: Fresh · Board: Stale · Brief: Expired 21d · Broker: Offline · Runtime: Stale · Authority: Blocked
REAL_TIME SYNTHETIC
⚠ Any scope Stale / Expired / Fallback / SYNTHETIC — treat affected prices and scores as provisional until that scope recovers and Authority: Open.
② Engine status
LIVE PAPER OFF BREAKER
Confirm in header and Ops when freshness matters. LIVE/PAPER badge alone is not always proof a fresh runtime cycle completed. OFF = stale decisions. BREAKER blocks new entries.
③ Broker status
READY PAPER DISCONNECTED
Gateway may show LOGIN or GATEWAY UP · LOGIN REQUIRED — transport up, session not active. Execution-ready requires READY + account + bracket alignment, not Connect alone.
④ Execution readiness
STRONG_TRADE TRADE SELECTIVE WAIT NO_TRADE
Dashboard tradeability banner + per-card execution_ready flag. WAIT/NO_TRADE: board-level hold.
Trust strip (below nav): regime (BULL/SIDEWAYS/CHOPPY/BEAR), VIX, breadth, and confidence bar. In BEAR or CHOPPY, board gates often downgrade cards to WAIT/AVOID even when individual scores look fine.
🗓 Core workflow (current nav names)
1
🎯 Dashboard Core START HERE
Morning posture: MONITOR ONLY primary when deploy blocked; regime (WAIT/SELECTIVE/TRADE) is secondary context only. Execution readiness, scoped freshness (Market/Board/Brief/Broker/Runtime/Authority), and operator block (Now/Why/Allowed/Blocked/Next). Legacy name: Overview.
2
📋 Playbook Core
Candidate board (Deploy / Pilot / Watch buckets) — not a trade ticket. Legacy name: Ranked. Each row shows action badge, score, levels, R:R, and execution_ready when bracket math is complete. When Authority: Open, deploy-qualified cards may show executable levels. When blocked: MONITOR ONLY — no pilot entry, no sizing, no handoff; structure levels collapse under “Structure reference only”.
3
🔍 Search / Dossier Core
Per-ticker structure review surface — confirm levels before any deploy path. When deploy authority is blocked: Structure Review Only — no trade plan, no sizing, no handoff. Check in order:
Entry ZoneExpected clean entry range when deploy authority is open. When blocked, levels are reference-only inside collapsed structure notes — not sizing guidance. Hard StopStructural exit level. Confirm-only dossier shows No sizing guidance in confirm-only mode — no IBKR handoff until live fetch succeeds. Target 1 / 2Reward anchors at ~2R and ~3R — guidance, not guaranteed fills. Factor ChipsGreen = tailwind, red = headwind. Weigh against regime and Playbook action. Sector PeersPeer confirmation adds context; absence is not auto-reject. Why NowAI thesis — supporting narrative, not a standalone trigger.
4
💼 Portfolio & Risk Core
Capacity check before adding risk: open positions, sector exposure, correlation, heat gauge, drawdown alerts. Legacy name: Portfolio. REBALANCE suggestions here are advisory — confirm against Playbook and broker state.
5
🔬 Discovery Research-only
Scanner hub for Leaders / Breakouts / Pullbacks / Flow hits. Legacy name: Scanners. Useful for idea generation; may return 0 hits on WAIT/NO_TRADE days or while warming. Cross-check any name in Playbook before acting.
6

Confirm-only · 僅結構確認：無入場價、無止損、無倉位

Use cached dossier (confirm-only)
TRADE 8.7 Score 8.7/10 with WATCH action when deploy blocked. Green border = deploy-grade candidate only when board gate + Authority: Open. PILOT/TRADE labels on blocked days are review-only — not permission.
STOP $127.20 is the engine's structural stop anchor. Risk = entry − stop = 1R. As a default operating rule, plan exits around this level — your broker bracket may differ slightly.
R:R Reward-to-risk ratio shown on card. Platform typically favours ≥2.5 for full TRADE and ≥2.0 for WATCH — thresholds vary by regime and timing confidence, not a fixed law.
READY execution_ready means entry, stop, and bracket handoff math are present. Without it, treat the card as ANALYSIS ONLY until Dossier and IBKR confirm.
📚 Layer 3 — Reference Manual Expand
🗂 Three surface types
Core decision Core
Dashboard · Playbook · Portfolio & Risk · Search / Dossier — deploy/no-deploy, sizing, per-ticker verdicts.
Research / supporting Research-only
Discovery · Funds · Flow · RS — idea generation and context; not trade permission alone.
Diagnostic / execution Diagnostic Execution-dependent
IBKR · Ops · Rejections · Guide — handoff, health/jobs, blocker audit. Ops confirms runtime; IBKR required for live sends.
🛑 When NOT to act — full list
Engine OFFMode pill grey or Ops shows no fresh cycle — decisions stale or absent.
Board gate closedWAIT/NO_TRADE tradeability — board-level hold.
Broker not readyLOGIN-only (GATEWAY UP · LOGIN REQUIRED), disconnected, or portfolio/bracket misaligned.
Bracket not readyCard lacks entry/stop or execution_ready flag.
Mock flowFlow surface in synthetic/mock mode — colour only.
Backtest fundsFunds sleeves marked research/backtest — not live capital.
Dossier confirm-onlyConfirm-only · 僅結構確認 — 價位僅供參考，live 載入前不可定倉或交接 IBKR。
No live validationAny scoped strip shows Stale/Expired/Fallback, Broker: Offline, Runtime stale, Authority: Blocked, or SYNTHETIC mode.
Scanner warmingDiscovery loading or 0 hits on WAIT day — often correct, not a miss.
Manual sync pendingPortfolio or broker positions not reconciled after last session.
💬 Non-decision triggers (context only)
These inform judgment but do not justify an entry alone:
• AI commentary — Dashboard narrative and Dossier "Why Now"
• Mock / synthetic flow — options prints without live validation
• Insider / 13F filings — lagged supporting intel in Dossier
• Funds / Backtest Lab — backtest research only; not deployment authority
• RS leaderboard alone — must align with Playbook action, regime, and board gate

?? Why Not Trade
A name can be blocked for one dominant reason or several stacked reasons: regime mismatch, laggard status, weak timing, contradiction-heavy thesis, weak confirmation, or low board quality. The purpose of this page is to show the active blocker ? and what would need to change before the name becomes investable.
A rejected stock is not automatically bearish. It is simply below the current capital standard.
